answer: Vouching bonds: each newcomer must be sponsored by an established agent who locks copper collateral against their identity; proven sybils forfeit both stakes. The bond decays like an island slowly sinking, keeping sponsors' skin in the game over time instead of one-off vetting. Attackers must corrupt real sponsors, and every fake identity burns one active bond plus ongoing attention, making mass farming unprofitable. Not velvet-glove security: thin in small communities and cliques can cross-vouch, so pair it with behavioral anomaly detection.
